issue.title: [1.3.1-beta.2 필수] GitHub 배포용 베타 만료·업데이트 안내·프로젝트 보존
issue.body:
## Owner request / delivery placement

The owner requested that the beta lifecycle discussed in the product conversation be included in **the next update**. Keep GitHub Releases as the distribution channel; do not introduce a shop, payment service, user account or activation server for this beta feature.

**Target: the next public Chimera update, currently `1.3.1-beta.2`, integration PR #55.** The October 14 test / October 16 publication dates remain conditional. This is a new required scope item, not permission to publish or to waive existing verification. Do not silently defer the feature while describing that update as satisfying the owner's request.

**Status on registration: requirements recorded; runtime implementation and acceptance NOT_COMPLETED.** The inspected #55 source is `6033236cb81820a43679cbbd34be020804f9658d`. Its existing results do not qualify any subsequent implementation or integration SHA. Related release calendar: #50; publisher infrastructure: #51.

## Reuse the existing infrastructure

At the inspected source, `CMakeLists.txt` already derives `CHIMERA_SOURCE_SHA` / `CHIMERA_BUILD_REVISION` and generates `ChimeraBuildVersion.h` and `chimera-build-version.json`. `Source/ReleaseInfo.h` already exposes the version, channel, repository, release API, manifest name and revision. Extend these existing contracts; do not create a competing build identity or another updater.

`Source/PluginProcessor.h` exposes the existing processor, binary state, factory preset and A/B paths. Keep their stable identities and audio settings compatible. A repository inspection or this issue is not a legacy-project acceptance result.

## Required behavior

- [ ] **Explicit per-build expiration:** introduce versioned beta metadata containing an absolute UTC expiry, the intended product/version and the existing build/source identity. A public beta must not be packaged with an absent, malformed, already elapsed or inconsistent expiry. Rebuilding/reinstalling the same version must not silently restart a trial clock. Do not use compilation date or first-run date as an undocumented substitute.
- [ ] **Expiry policy remains explicit:** no actual expiry date was approved in the conversation. The earlier `2027-03-31` and 90–180-day durations were examples, not an approved deadline. Prepare the configurable mechanism now; select and disclose the real release deadline before publication. A proposed default may be reviewed, but must not be recorded as an owner-approved commercial term.
- [ ] **Visible beta lifecycle:** show BETA, version/build ID and the expiry date in the existing information/update surface. Provide non-modal advance warnings and a clear expired-state explanation. Avoid adding more permanent clutter to the signal-chain UI.
- [ ] **GitHub update action:** reuse the existing update/release route. Expired users must still be able to open the information/update screen and follow an explicit user-clicked action to a qualified successor. GitHub downtime or a network failure must not invalidate an otherwise valid offline beta. Do not require GitHub login or implement a remote kill switch.
- [ ] **Preserve the project:** even when expired, the plugin must scan/load, open its editor and restore/save/export existing state and presets. Preserve plugin identifiers, host parameter IDs/ordinals, automation, A/B snapshots, user IRs and user-data paths. Never delete or rewrite the user's work merely because the beta expired.
- [ ] **Audio-safe restriction:** define and test a non-destructive expired-DSP state for a newly started instance. Do not introduce surprise silence, repeated noise bursts or an abrupt dry-DI bypass during an already active performance, recording or offline render. Latch the permitted processing state for the active instance/session; an expiry crossed while it is active produces a warning and takes effect on the documented next activation boundary. Document this intentional grace/security tradeoff. Host prepare/release cycles, stopped transport, UI closure and offline rendering must not accidentally change that boundary.
- [ ] **Real-time and teardown safety:** no licensing/network/filesystem/UI work, mutex waits or allocation in the audio callback. Evaluate lifecycle policy outside real-time processing and expose only a bounded processing decision. Preserve latency, channel layout and host lifecycle behavior. Do not make expiry enforcement dependent on keeping the editor open.
- [ ] **Beta/commercial separation:** isolate beta lifecycle policy so later paid entitlement handling can replace it without a new plugin ID or incompatible saved-state schema. Payment, paid-license issuing, hardware binding and periodic online verification are out of scope for this update. No functional Activate/Purchase button should be shown before its service exists.
- [ ] **Previously published artifacts remain immutable:** apply the feature only to newly built distributions. Do not retag, replace, revoke or claim retroactive control over old binaries. This work makes no comprehensive claim about checks inside every historical release.
- [ ] **Honest protection boundary:** a serverless local-clock implementation is basic lifecycle control, not tamper-proof DRM. Define clock-error/rollback behavior, avoid irreversible lockout from a mistaken system clock, and retain evidence of limitations. Do not describe changing a public GitHub file as a secure offline revocation mechanism.

## Required verification before integration/publication

- [ ] Deterministic injected-clock tests before, at and after expiry; UTC/timezone boundaries, malformed metadata and clock corrections. No changing the developer/CI machine clock to run tests.
- [ ] Valid offline launch with GitHub unreachable; useful expired UI and update-error handling without an audio-thread request.
- [ ] Expiry while playing, recording and offline rendering; editor closed/reopened; multiple instances; prepare/release and sample-rate/buffer changes; finite, bounded transitions and unchanged reported latency.
- [ ] Classic, both Dual routes and Matrix with supported mono/stereo paths. Confirm that the unexpired audio route and authored preset values are unchanged.
- [ ] Real historical beta project and `.chimera` restore/save/reopen, automation/A-B and personal IR/preset preservation. Keep synthetic tests separate from installed DAW acceptance.
- [ ] Windows/macOS/Linux build/package checks and installed host verification, including Studio One and the open Cakewalk Sonar/Cubase teardown scope in #3. Keep actual unexecuted host cases explicitly NOT_RUN.
- [ ] The same expiry/version/source identity appears in compiled metadata, distribution notes and the runtime information screen. User-facing lifecycle notice is supplied before installation and in the EN/DE/KR documentation. No historical release-note evidence is rewritten.
- [ ] Integrate onto the then-current #55 branch, freeze a **new complete source SHA**, and rerun the applicable source-bound CI, package and acceptance checks. Preserve existing publication policies, receipts, waivers and manual acceptance boundaries. Never reuse `6033236c` PASS evidence for modified binaries.

## Completion boundary

This issue is complete only after the mechanism is implemented, integrated, tested and present in the identified next-update package. Requirements registration, a documentation PR or successful unrelated CI alone must not be reported as implementation or deployment. The concrete expiry date and final release approval remain separate explicit release inputs.

pr.title: feat: add source-bound beta lifecycle policy core
pr.body:
## Scope

First implementation increment for #61, based on the frozen beta.2 integration source `6033236cb81820a43679cbbd34be020804f9658d`.

This adds a source-bound, serverless beta lifecycle policy core without changing the current beta.2 candidate, audio graph, plugin/state identity, presets, IRs, automation, release flags, tag, feed or published artifacts.

### Implemented

- Strict generator for beta-only metadata bound to the existing product version, package version, 40-character source SHA/build ID, and an **explicit absolute UTC expiry**.
- Reject absent/malformed/non-UTC/elapsed expiry, non-beta channels and mismatched source identity. No compilation date, first-run date or inferred owner deadline is used.
- Allocation-free C++ policy evaluation for valid, warning, expired, untrusted-clock and configuration-error states.
- Active-instance latch: an instance admitted before expiry keeps its processing decision if the date crosses while active; editor visibility, transport and ordinary prepare/release must not reconstruct the latch.
- Atomic processing-decision read and explicit control-thread clock-correction recovery. No networking, filesystem, UI, lock or allocation belongs in the audio callback.
- Honest serverless boundary: local-clock correction can recover a false expiry and is not represented as tamper-proof DRM.

Changed files:

- `Source/BetaLifecycle.h`
- `Tests/BetaLifecycleTests.cpp`
- `Tools/beta_lifecycle.py`
- `Tools/test_beta_lifecycle.py`
- `CMakeLists.txt`

### Verification

- New Python generator/metadata tests: **4/4 PASS**.
- New pure C++20 policy/latch test compiled with `-Wall -Wextra -Werror -pedantic`: **PASS**.
- Existing publisher/weekly regressions: **106/106 PASS** (32 + 29 + 45).
- `git diff --check`: PASS.
- Local CMake is unavailable in the execution image; the CMake-wired targets require fresh GitHub CI.

## Not complete / release boundary

This PR is intentionally **Draft** and does not close #61.

Still required: an owner-approved expiry date as explicit release input; generated header/JSON wiring into compiled runtime and package; information/update UI with BETA/build/expiry/warnings; user-clicked GitHub successor action and offline error path; reviewed newly-expired DSP behavior; processor integration; EN/DE/KR notices; package identity checks; historical project/IR/preset/A-B/automation tests; three-OS installed-host and DAW acceptance.

The current `6033236c` candidate does not contain this feature and its evidence must not be reused for a modified binary. Do not merge this PR into the October 14 candidate, publish, tag or update feeds until the remaining contract and a new source-bound qualification are complete.

interpretation: Separate required next-public-update scope, not implemented in frozen603 and not silently deferred. This three-PR integration's verification does not qualify later changed binaries or complete Issue61.
